# Coimbra Tech Atlas — Company directory

> A model-friendly edition of the Coimbra Tech Atlas directory, covering technology companies with a confirmed presence in the Coimbra region of Portugal.

- **Canonical website:** [Coimbra Tech Atlas](https://rgilsimoes.github.io/coimbra-tech-atlas/)
- **Portuguese edition:** [Atlas Tecnológico de Coimbra](https://rgilsimoes.github.io/coimbra-tech-atlas/pt/)
- **Profiles in this edition:** 36
- **Last reviewed:** November 2026

This is an independent editorial directory, not an official commercial register. “Coimbra area” includes the municipality and nearby business districts. Company facts can change; follow the primary source attached to each profile before making definitive claims.
